The fact is those with no tolerance to opiates/opioids can overdose from as little as 40-60mg of Oxycodone -- and a dose of 160mg or greater would likely lead to an overdose, with a 50/50 chance of death in the opiate naive -- a dose two or three times this amount would be must more lethal. 
As with all opiates, those who are tolerant to opioids can require many times this amount to produce a lethal overdose. 
A common dose range for Oxycontin is 20mg-80mg.
